title: $8,500 FaZe Tournament Clipping Campaign
description:
FaZe Flank Invitational (Call of Duty), live on Twitch Nov 10 to 12.
Clip the draft, clutch plays and reactions from the official broadcast only.
FaZe Flank logo on every clip, required caption tags, 60%+ US audience.
$2 CPM, up to $350 per clip. 
Top clippers get invited to our private team.

source.permission_quote: Clip the draft, clutch plays and reactions from the official broadcast only.

guidelines:
Only clip the official FaZe Flank Invitational broadcast (twitch.tv/faze, twitch.tv/zoomaa) or the players' own POV streams
Keep the FaZe Flank Invitational logo on screen for the whole clip, never over the action
Caption must include @FaZeClan @ZooMaa @TheFlank #FaZeFlankInvitational, plus featured player and team handles when shown
60%+ US audience required
Hook in the first second: open on the play, the pick or the reaction
Every clip must be an edit, no full VODs or unedited stream segments
Never make FaZe, CDL teams or players look bad, no fake results, fake drama or misleading scores
Vertical 9:16, at least 7 seconds
No carousels, collab posts, politics or religion
Keep every clip public for at least 3 months
Full rules in the guidelines
